from pyspark.sql.functions import col, lit, current_date, current_timestamp, crc32, abs, concat_ws
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

# 1. Define Paths
source_path = "abfss://source@storageadflearntcs.dfs.core.windows.net/csvfiles/Emp_Source/customers_scd2_test.csv"
target_path = "abfss://target@storageadflearntcs.dfs.core.windows.net/deltafiles/customers_delta"

# 2. Read Source
df_source = spark.read.option("header", "true").csv(source_path)

# 3. Load Target Delta Table
deltaTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, target_path)
df_target = deltaTable.toDF()

# 4. Identify Existing Active Records That Changed
df_active_target = df_target.filter(col("IsCurrent") == 1)

# Explicitly compare columns to detect changes (ignoring MD5 entirely)
change_condition = (
    ~(df_source["FirstName"].eqNullSafe(df_active_target["FirstName"])) |
    ~(df_source["LastName"].eqNullSafe(df_active_target["LastName"])) |
    ~(df_source["City"].eqNullSafe(df_active_target["City"])) |
    ~(df_source["State"].eqNullSafe(df_active_target["State"])) |
    ~(df_source["Email"].eqNullSafe(df_active_target["Email"])) |
    ~(df_source["PhoneNumber"].cast("string").eqNullSafe(df_active_target["PhoneNumber"].cast("string")))
)

df_updates = df_source.join(
    df_active_target,
    on="CustomerID",
    how="inner"
).filter(change_condition).select(df_source["*"])

# 5. Build Staging Dataset (Merge Key: CustomerID for updates to expire; NULL for new inserts)
df_staged = df_source.withColumn("MERGE_KEY", col("CustomerID")) \
    .unionByName(
        df_updates.withColumn("MERGE_KEY", lit(None))
    )

# 6. Execute SCD Type 2 Merge via Python DeltaTable API
update_condition = """
    NOT (target.FirstName <=> src.FirstName) OR 
    NOT (target.LastName <=> src.LastName) OR 
    NOT (target.City <=> src.City) OR 
    NOT (target.State <=> src.State) OR 
    NOT (target.Email <=> src.Email) OR 
    NOT (CAST(target.PhoneNumber AS STRING) <=> CAST(src.PhoneNumber AS STRING))
"""

deltaTable.alias("target").merge(
    source=df_staged.alias("src"),
    condition="target.CustomerID = src.MERGE_KEY AND target.IsCurrent = 1"
).whenMatchedUpdate(
    condition=update_condition,
    set={
        "IsCurrent": lit(0),
        "EndDate": current_date()
    }
).whenNotMatchedInsert(
    values={
        "CustomerSK": abs(crc32(concat_ws("_", col("src.CustomerID"), current_timestamp()))),
        "CustomerID": col("src.CustomerID"),
        "FirstName": col("src.FirstName"),
        "LastName": col("src.LastName"),
        "Email": col("src.Email"),
        "City": col("src.City"),
        "State": col("src.State"),
        "PhoneNumber": col("src.PhoneNumber"),
        "StartDate": current_date(),
        "EndDate": lit("9999-12-31"),
        "IsCurrent": lit(1)
    }
).execute()

print("SCD Type 2 Merge completed successfully.")
